findings.message: Match the workspace folder to the actual repository mount. When the checkout directory is not exactly `ProxmoxMCP-Plus`, including differently named clones and Codespaces checkouts, the default workspace mount remains `/workspaces/<checkout-name>`. Setting `workspaceFolder` does not change that mount, so VS Code opens a nonexistent directory and the post-create installation cannot run against the repository. Use a dynamic workspace path or explicitly configure a matching `workspaceMount`, and update the interpreter path accordingly.

Install development dependencies from an available definition. The active Hatchling configuration in `pyproject.toml` defines no `dev` optional dependency group; the extras in `setup.py` are not used by this build backend. Consequently, this command installs the application but not pytest, pytest-asyncio, mypy, or the other development dependencies into the new environment. Install `requirements-dev.in` as well, or define the extra in `pyproject.toml`, so the advertised development environment can run the tests.
